message: So, the other night I was cooking dinner when the smoke alarm went off. Cue the family group chat lighting up with messages like "Is the house on fire?!" 😅 I assured everyone it was just my overzealous sautéing! But it got me thinking about how important it is to have a fire escape plan—and to keep those smoke alarms in check. It’s funny how a little kitchen mishap turned into a reminder to keep our family safe. Anyone else had a similar moment?
